## About

## Projects

### Interview Copilot
AI interview practice app with text and camera/voice modes.
- AI interviewer covering DSA, system design, OOP and behavioural questions
- Voice pipeline: browser audio capture → Whisper transcription → DeepSeek evaluation (correctness, communication, confidence, optimisation, missing points)
- Session history, score-trend analytics, local fallback evaluator
Tech: TypeScript, React 19, TanStack Start, Tailwind CSS, Whisper, DeepSeek (OpenRouter)
Repo: https://github.com/HostileCoder006/ai-interview-copilot

### QuantTrader AI
Stock analysis and decision-support platform with NIFTY 50 paper trading.
- Deterministic signal engine (RSI, MACD, VWAP, EMA, ATR); LLM explains signals only
- Backtester + Strategy Lab: Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, win rate; next-bar execution
- Market-regime engine, similar-setup search, multi-analyst AI investment committee
Tech: Python, Flask, SQLite, Pandas, NumPy, yfinance, React, TypeScript, DeepSeek V3.2

### Edge-Based Predictive Maintenance for CNC Machines
Anomaly detection and health scoring from multi-sensor machine data.
- Vibration, temperature, pressure and sound data → anomaly detection + health score
- Real-time Streamlit dashboard for monitoring and efficiency insights
Tech: Python, Pandas, Streamlit, Machine Learning
